_schema: Fetch targets for services/source_fetcher.py. Nothing is fetched unless permission_status is "permitted", endpoint_url is https, AND the owner's source registry (config/sources_registry.json) holds a permitted, enabled annual_report entry for the symbol whose url_pattern matches the endpoint. The polling_schedule is read by the external scheduler that runs `python -m services.source_fetcher --once`; the fetcher does not schedule itself.

_fields.company_id: integer identifier in the operational database (owner to supply; null while paused)
_fields.endpoint_url: https URL of the filing endpoint, or null while paused
_fields.permission_status: permitted | paused (anything else is refused; the default is paused)
_fields.polling_schedule: cron expression or interval text for the external scheduler, e.g. "0 2 * * *" (off-peak)
_fields.intake: optional: the intake profile used to diagnose a new PDF (period_end, columns, unit_scale, consolidation, currency, page_map)
